T0550.title: Data Classification and Grading
T0550.definition: A governance practice that categorizes data by sensitivity, business value, and required protection level.
T0550.description: Data classification and grading defines protection requirements according to sensitivity and business value. Without a classification foundation, access control, encryption, masking, DLP, and retention policies are hard to apply precisely. Controls focus on standards, automated discovery, human review, tag inheritance, and cross-system consistency.
T0550.usageExample: Assess Data Classification and Grading related exposure and define the corresponding controls.
